verdict.rationale: Deepgram exposes broad API surface (unified WebSocket agent API, reusable agent configs manageable via the Console API, OpenAPI spec, CLI covering transcription/synthesis/account management) suggesting most configuration done in the Console has an API equivalent (e.g., reusable agent config UUIDs, A/B testing without code deploys). However, there is no explicit documentation stating that every Console UI feature (e.g., analytics dashboards, billing, team management) is fully API-accessible. missing for 10: explicit parity statement or docs confirming all UI/console features (analytics, billing, account management) are exposed via API, independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
